dct_description_sm:
Contains all data for the map "Eastern Native Population, Early 17th Century" in the unit Native Population and Subsistence, 17th Century in the Historical Atlas of Canada Online Learning Project.

View data in 'tree' view to download the data for specific maps. Documentation and file location found in the file: HACOLP_Nat_Pop_East_17C_Distribution_Info_20161207.pdf

NB: Other maps in this unit not included in Byron Moldofsky's distribution folder but that we could probably make available in this same dataset:
"Linguistic Families, 17th Century", "Eastern Native Population, Early 17th Century", "Native Subsistence at European Contact, Ethnohistoric Data", and Native Subsistence, 1000 CE to European Contact, Archaeological Data"
